```{r global-options, include=FALSE}
# Code chunks are shown but not executed: the analysis needs the input files of the
```

# Colocalization

This document merges the six colocalization scripts of the Colocalization folder. For
every prioritized gene or protein the cis-region is rebuilt from the eQTL/pQTL summary
statistics, harmonised against the sleep apnea GWAS and analysed with coloc.abf.

The scripts differ only in the width of the cis window (100 kb, 250 kb and 500 kb) and
in the molecular layer (gene expression versus plasma protein).

## Notes on the merged code

* Each section below holds one source file of this folder, and the file name is given
  both in the section heading and in the first comment line of the chunk.
* Every path that pointed at the analysis tree of the original workstation is rewritten
  to a short relative path below the placeholder root `Path/`; `Path/datasource/` stands
  for the input data, `Path/R-4.3.1/bin/` for the R interpreter and
  `Path/SMR/smr-1.3.1-win-x86_64/` for the SMR executable. Point them at your own
  installation before running the code.
* The Chinese comments and chunk titles of the original scripts are given in English;
  the date of the original document header is not part of this merged file.
* Shell scripts are kept in their own `bash` chunks.

---

## `eQTL_SleepApnea_colocalization_100kb.Rmd`

```{r "eQTL_SleepApnea_colocalization_100kb.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================
# Source file: eQTL_SleepApnea_colocalization_100kb.Rmd (R code)
# ===========================================================================
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: setup
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(MendelianRandomization)
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
library(TwoSampleMR)
library(plinkbinr)
library(ieugwasr)
library(ggplot2)
library(mr.raps)
library(coloc)
library(stringr)
library(locuscomparer)
library(WhopGenome)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chunk: Blood genes
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rm(list = ls())

setwd("Path/Colocalization/")

mr_res<-read_excel("Path/SMR/Sig_Blood_SleepApnea.xlsx",sheet = "Sheet 1")
mr_res$ProbeChr<-as.character(mr_res$ProbeChr)
probe_list<-mr_res$probeID
gene_list<-mr_res$Gene
chr_list<-mr_res$ProbeChr
bp_list<-c(25071848,36621803,153940379,154540257,155200766,168511975,183441638,243219696,243265035,243418352,243419358,24346350,28718938,36825334,54342641,85766288,102972389,135676395,136288806,136633996,157291953,40494796,40498783,48723360,49044495,50654601,50707420,101395319,107241783,108321680,126194762,683230,967344,980785,25378835,31999019,43602825,96143803,112849380,40555204,12250926,72395660,74188309,74310231,74587848,75123401,75157453,76633979,76640868,120628731,8102189,10964214,10967236,11415531,95087632,98270943,136150617,141069497,76970509,104629273,13299345,113258513,28343299,58329958,110011679,110011617,124086646,21141208,36278510,50065415,52043758,1031596,21807080,29466285,30134615,30346375,55496209,27038872,28257170,45569858,79995608,80191563,21083473,4066943,4186418,33071974,41317295,3185331,45079429,18111584,41601209,42017100,42230669,42486032,42526908)

#Create the colocalization summary table
coloc_res<-data.frame(gene=NA,sleep=NA,nsnps=NA,PPH0=NA,PPH1=NA,PPH2=NA,PPH3=NA,PPH4=NA,snp=NA,position=NA,V.df1=NA,z.df1=NA,r.df1=NA,lABF.df1=NA,V.df2=NA,z.df2=NA,r.df2=NA,lABF.df2=NA,internal.sum.lABF=NA,SNP.PP.H4=NA)

#Load the sleep apnea data and run the preprocessing steps
load("Path/datasource/GWAS_data/sleepapnoea_FINNGEN_R12_allSNP_hg19.RData")
SleepApnea <- dat_allSNP_hg19
rm(dat_allSNP_hg19)
SleepApnea<- subset(SleepApnea, SleepApnea$FREQ<1)
SleepApnea<- SleepApnea[order(SleepApnea$P,decreasing = FALSE),]
SleepApnea<- SleepApnea[!duplicated(SleepApnea$SNP),]
SleepApnea$CHR<-as.character(SleepApnea$CHR)

for (i in 1:nrow(mr_res)) {
  gene<-fread(paste("Path/datasource/eQTL_data/Whole_Blood/SleepApnea/blood_",probe_list[i],".txt",sep = ""))
  gene$Chr<-as.character(gene$Chr)
  setnames(gene,c("Chr","b","SE","A1","A2"),c("CHR","Beta","se","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"))
  
  sleep_dat<-subset(SleepApnea,SleepApnea$CHR==chr_list[i])
  sleep_dat<-subset(SleepApnea,SleepApnea$BP<bp_list[i]+100000)
  sleep_dat<-subset(SleepApnea,SleepApnea$BP>bp_list[i]-100000)
  
  #merge
  merge1<-merge(gene,sleep_dat,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),
                suffixes=c(".gene",".sl"))
  flip_pro <- dplyr::rename(gene,Effect_Allele=Other_Allele,Other_Allele=Effect_Allele)
  flip_pro$Beta = 0-gene$Beta
  merge2 <- merge(flip_pro,sleep_dat,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),suffixes=c(".gene",".sl"))
  input <- rbind(merge1,merge2)
  input <- as.data.frame(input)
  
  gene_format<-format_data(input,type = "exposure",snps = NULL,header = TRUE,snp_col = "SNP.gene",chr_col = "CHR",pos_col = "BP",effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",eaf_col = "Freq",beta_col = "Beta",se_col = "se",pval_col = "p")
  sleep_format<-format_data(input,type = "outcome",snps = gene_format$SNP,header = TRUE,snp_col = "SNP.sl",chr_col = "CHR",pos_col = "BP",effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",eaf_col = "FREQ",beta_col = "BETA",se_col = "BETA_SE",pval_col = "P")
  har<-harmonise_data(gene_format,sleep_format,action = 1)
  har<-subset(har,har$mr_keep==TRUE)
  har$MAF<-ifelse(har$eaf.outcome<0.5,har$eaf.outcome,1-har$eaf.outcome)
  har$N<-558
  write.csv(har,paste("har/bloodgene/",gene_list[i],"_SleepApnea_har_100kb.csv",sep = ""))

  result <- coloc.abf(dataset1=list(snp=har$SNP,beta=har$beta.outcome,
                        varbeta=(har$se.outcome)^2,position=har$pos.outcome,type="cc"),
                        
                      dataset2=list(snp=har$SNP,beta=har$beta.exposure,
                        varbeta=(har$se.exposure)^2,position=har$pos.exposure,
                        type="quant",N=har$N,MAF=har$MAF)
                      )
  
  need_result=(result$results %>% dplyr::arrange(desc(SNP.PP.H4)))[1,]
    
  #record results
  need_result$gene<-gene_list[i]
  need_result$sleep<-"SleepApnea"
  need_result$nsnps<-result[["summary"]][["nsnps"]]
  need_result$PPH0<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H0.abf"]]
  need_result$PPH1<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H1.abf"]]
  need_result$PPH2<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H2.abf"]]
  need_result$PPH3<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H3.abf"]]
  need_result$PPH4<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H4.abf"]]
  
  coloc_res<-rbind(coloc_res,need_result)
}

coloc_res<-coloc_res[-1,]

write.xlsx(coloc_res,file = file.path("BloodGene_SleepApnea_colocalization_100kb.xlsx"))

                        varbeta=(har$se.exposure)^2,position=har$pos.exposure,
                        type="quant",N=har$N,MAF=har$MAF)
                      )
  
  need_result=(result$results %>% dplyr::arrange(desc(SNP.PP.H4)))[1,]
    
  #record results
  need_result$gene<-gene_list[i]
  need_result$sleep<-"SleepApnea"
```

```{r "eQTL_SleepApnea_colocalization_250kb.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
# ===========================================================================

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

mr_res$ProbeChr<-as.character(mr_res$ProbeChr)

chr_list<-mr_res$ProbeChr
```
```{r "pQTL_SleepApnea_colocalization_100kb.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
bp_list<-c(136594750,136743254,95768984,102201714,30134615,46908396)

#Create the colocalization summary table
coloc_res<-data.frame(protein=NA,sleep=NA,nsnps=NA,PPH0=NA,PPH1=NA,PPH2=NA,PPH3=NA,PPH4=NA,snp=NA,position=NA,V.df1=NA,z.df1=NA,r.df1=NA,lABF.df1=NA,V.df2=NA,z.df2=NA,r.df2=NA,lABF.df2=NA,internal.sum.lABF=NA,SNP.PP.H4=NA)

#Load the sleep apnea data and run the preprocessing steps
load("Path/datasource/GWAS_data/sleepapnoea_FINNGEN_R12_allSNP_hg19.RData")
SleepApnea <- dat_allSNP_hg19
rm(dat_allSNP_hg19)
SleepApnea<- subset(SleepApnea, SleepApnea$FREQ<1)
SleepApnea<- SleepApnea[order(SleepApnea$P,decreasing = FALSE),]
SleepApnea<- SleepApnea[!duplicated(SleepApnea$SNP),]

for (i in 1:nrow(mr_res)) {
  protein<-fread(paste("Path/datasource/pQTL_data/ARIC/SleepApnea/",
                       gene_list[i],".txt",sep = ""))
  protein$Chr<-as.integer(protein$Chr)
  setnames(protein,c("Chr","Bp","A1","A2"),c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"))

  sleep_dat<-subset(SleepApnea,SleepApnea$CHR==as.integer(chr_list[i]))
```
```{r "pQTL_SleepApnea_colocalization_250kb.Rmd", eval=FALSE}
  sleep_dat<-subset(SleepApnea,SleepApnea$BP<bp_list[i]+250000)
  sleep_dat<-subset(SleepApnea,SleepApnea$BP>bp_list[i]-250000)
  
  #merge
  merge1<-merge(protein,sleep_dat,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),
                suffixes=c(".pr",".sl"))
  flip_pro <- dplyr::rename(protein,Effect_Allele=Other_Allele,Other_Allele=Effect_Allele)
  flip_pro$Beta = 0-protein$Beta
  merge2 <- merge(flip_pro,sleep_dat,by=c("CHR","BP","Effect_Allele","Other_Allele"),
                suffixes=c(".pr",".sl"))
  input <- rbind(merge1,merge2)
  input <- as.data.frame(input)
  
  protein_format<-format_data(input,type = "exposure",snps = NULL,header = TRUE,snp_col = "SNP.pr",chr_col = "CHR",pos_col = "BP",effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",eaf_col = "Freq",beta_col = "Beta",se_col = "se",pval_col = "p")
  sleep_format<-format_data(input,type = "outcome",snps = protein_format$SNP,header = TRUE,snp_col = "SNP.sl",chr_col = "CHR",pos_col = "BP",effect_allele_col = "Effect_Allele",other_allele_col = "Other_Allele",eaf_col = "FREQ",beta_col = "BETA",se_col = "BETA_SE",pval_col = "P")
  har<-harmonise_data(protein_format,sleep_format,action = 2)
  har<-subset(har,har$mr_keep==TRUE)
  har$N<-7213
  har$MAF<-ifelse(har$eaf.exposure<0.5,har$eaf.exposure,1-har$eaf.exposure)
  write.csv(har,paste("har/plasmaprotein/",gene_list[i],"_SleepApnea_har_250kb.csv",sep = ""))

  result <- coloc.abf(dataset1=list(snp=har$SNP,beta=har$beta.outcome,
                        varbeta=(har$se.outcome)^2,position=har$pos.outcome,type="cc"),
                        
                      dataset2=list(snp=har$SNP,beta=har$beta.exposure,
                        varbeta=(har$se.exposure)^2,position=har$pos.exposure,
                        type="quant",N=har$N,MAF=har$MAF)
                      )
  
  need_result=(result$results %>% dplyr::arrange(desc(SNP.PP.H4)))[1,]
    
  #record results
  need_result$protein<-gene_list[i]
  need_result$sleep<-"SleepApnea"
  need_result$nsnps<-result[["summary"]][["nsnps"]]
  need_result$PPH0<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H0.abf"]]
  need_result$PPH1<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H1.abf"]]
  need_result$PPH2<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H2.abf"]]
  need_result$PPH3<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H3.abf"]]
  need_result$PPH4<-result[["summary"]][["PP.H4.abf"]]
  
  coloc_res<-rbind(coloc_res,need_result)
}

coloc_res<-coloc_res[-1,]

write.xlsx(coloc_res,file = file.path("PlasmaPro_SleepApnea_colocalization_250kb.xlsx"))
```
